# Ludovic Speed & Theodora Dix

- [Ludovic Speed](../character/ludovic-speed.md) — Romantically involved with — [Theodora Dix](../character/theodora-dix.md) — placid courtship helped along by Anne · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Again P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P19](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0019), [v3 ch.People P19](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0019), +1 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) completes her first term at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holidays. She is warmly welcomed by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), and [Dora](../character/dora.md), and she comforts [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) through a bedtime confession. Over the holidays, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives letters from friends, visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and enjoys reuniting with her loved ones.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VII Home Again

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys her summer in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) despite feeling a lonely ache from Gilbert's absence and lack of letters. She spends time with [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) while [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) confronts the reality of growing up and leaving childhood imaginings behind. Later, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her relationship with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), gently warning her that they were meant for each other.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIII Paul Cannot Find the Rock People

> In a letter to Philippa, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) describes her new boarding situation at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside) in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) with Miss [Janet](../character/janet.md) Sweet. She describes the charmingly peculiar home, her hostess's background, and the local characters including a taciturn hired boy. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) also teases that she is observing another local elderly love affair, though she vows not to meddle this time.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXI Anne to Philippa
